messages:
release-manager: Draft release notes attached — aiming for a 10:00-12:00 PT change window tomorrow. Need ops handoff and confirmation we'll pin model-server to v2.14.0 for the rollout. Planning to send internal announce ~1h before. Draft snippet below, pls review for wording and rollback plan.

release-manager: ```
- Feature: improved batching heuristics to reduce p95 latency by ~12%
- Small config change: default batch_size=64 -> 48 for low-memory hosts
- Note: we are pinning model-server v2.14.0 (bundle sha: 9f8a7b2) for this release
- Impact: no schema changes; rolling restart will occur across Dedicated pools
- Rollback: immediate pin to previous bundle (v2.13.7) if latency/regressions occur
```

devops-bot: DeployBot: Canary job queued for staging -> prod canary at 2026-04-22T17:00:00Z. Required approvers: @aj, @samir. Reply `approve` to trigger.

aj: :thumbsup: I can approve the canary. Quick Q: any DB migration or cache flush needed?

release-manager: No DB migration. Only rolling restarts and cache warmup; I'll kick cache refresh job after canary passes.

maria: Heads up — Customer Ops has a sync at 11:00 PT with a large customer. Can we shift announce later or at least avoid mass alerts during that slot? :eyes:

olivia: Suggest keep change window 10-12 but delay internal blast until 11:15 so Customer Ops can prep. Release notes look good, please add a short troubleshooting snippet for stalled KV cache (we saw this last minor rollout).

samir: Rollback play: if p95 latency increases >20% for >5 minutes OR error rate >1.5% -> immediate pin to v2.13.7 and revert config. Commands:```
# pin back to previous bundle
redwoodctl release pin --service model-server --bundle 9d4c1e2 --env prod
# trigger rolling restart
redwoodctl rollout restart --service model-server --env prod
```
I'll own the rollback and will open the incident channel if triggered.

kate: Add a short line in notes about rate-limiter tweak and fallback to small-model when memory pressure observed. Also mention expected token-cost delta (~+2-3%).

release-manager: Good catches. I'll: 1) add KV cache troubleshooting snippet, 2) add rate-limiter note & cost delta, 3) schedule internal announce at 11:15 PT. @aj please approve canary when ready; @samir you'll be on-call for rollback.

devops-bot: DeployBot: Canary job requires explicit `approve` from listed approvers to proceed. Link to canary job: https://deploy.redwood.internal/jobs/3421

aj: approve — kicking canary now. I'll monitor perf dashboards and the token-cost metric.

release-manager: Thanks — I'll update the internal announcement copy and drop the final in #eng-releases 1h before. If anything changes we pivot to rollback plan. :white_check_mark:
